context_for_next_testing_agent: User Scoring System fully tested. Key features: 1) /admin/users page shows Score column with badges (Alto/hot=red+Flame, Medio/warm=amber+TrendingUp, Frio/cold=blue+Snowflake, Sin datos=grey). 2) Score badges have data-testid='user-score-{id}'. 3) Mobile view (390px) shows card layout with data-testid='mobile-user-{id}'. 4) Cards show avatar, name, email, score badge, balances (USD/EUR), action buttons (Saldo, Rol, Susp.). 5) Admin Withdrawals mobile view shows accordion sections with mobile card rows. 6) Backend scheduler jobs: process_user_scoring (hourly) calculates hot/warm/cold based on login frequency, balance, activity. process_user_reminders (12h) sends notifications for pending processes and available balance. 7) Scoring fields in DB: interest_score (hot/warm/cold), interest_label (Alto interes/Medio/Frio), score_data (logins_7d, balance, days_inactive, has_pending_withdrawal, updated_at).
